cells.gaps: No source found reports Egyptian payments running on PAPSS: the CBE joined in November 2024, and six banks were still seeking its approval to integrate in September 2026.
cells.note: The CBE runs the Instant Payment Network, the national real-time infrastructure behind InstaPay. It joined PAPSS in November 2024, but in September 2026 six banks were still applying to integrate, so no live participation has been found.
